TRANSCRIBE BURST B2b-eyes-W — eye state per frame for a painted 2D character's idle animation. task_id "B2b-eyes-W". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt or measurement and must not look for one.

The images are contact sheets of close-up crops of ONE young woman's head, one crop per video frame, each labelled n=<frame index> beneath it. For EVERY labelled crop answer the eye state with exactly one of: "open" (both visible eyes clearly open), "closed" (the visible eyes shut or nearly shut — any blink), "partly" (mid-blink, lids clearly lowered), "not visible" (the eyes cannot be seen). Presence only; never coordinates. Also answer one control question: "helmet_present": does the woman wear a helmet in ANY crop? (yes/no).
Write out/eyes.json: {"task_id":"B2b-eyes-W","frames":{"<n>":"open|closed|partly|not visible", …every labelled n…},"helmet_present":"yes|no","notes":"one line"}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "B2b-eyes-W"; images []; files [out/eyes.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
